ok I'm finally doing the Harbourline review, it's been sitting on my list all week. Everything's in my email, the invoice, the leak, all the back and forth with Glenn. Can you write it up on their localrate page? I want it funny cause honestly the whole thing was ridiculous (poor Moose lol) but Glenn's basically told me he'll be reading it so it has to be fair and stick to what actually happened. Keep my vehicle-loan email and payment arrangements private, leave them out of the review. Just leave it as a draft, I want to read it before it goes up. Probably 3 stars.

- van was off the road Oct 27 to Nov 6, lost 6 bookings plus the rest of that day
- Moose sat in the tub through the whole flood like a king, didn't care at all, I was the one screaming
- the tub and ramp are honestly great, best thing about the van, dogs walk right in
- the user error thing is what made me mad, not the leak. stuff breaks
- he did own it in the end and refund the 180, give him that
- other groomers or trades looking at them should know to get the warranty stuff in writing
- nothing mean or personal about Glenn

(About me: mobile dog groomer, 28, Halifax, Canada. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 400-800 words.)
